args: c="${PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/puppeteer}"; e=$(ls -d "$c"/chrome/*/chrome-*/"Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing" "$c"/chrome/*/chrome-linux64/chrome 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -n "$e" ] || e=$(bunx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome@stable --path "$c" --format "{{path}}" </dev/null) || exit 1; exec bunx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --headless --isolated --viewport=1920x1080 --no-performance-crux --no-usage-statistics --executablePath "$e"
